title: RentGuard Billing Manual — Share of the Year for a Discount Stop, by Billing Plan
content:
Stop proration by billing plan applies to every RentGuard Renters Policy that owes a charge for the stop of its multi-policy discount. The share of the year charged for the stop is set by the billing plan of the renters policy.

**Rule.** On a renters policy billed on the monthly EFT plan or the monthly card plan, the share of the year charged for the stop is the number of whole 30-day periods in the days charged for the stop, counted downward, divided by 12; on a renters policy billed on the two-pay plan, it is the days charged for the stop divided by 360; on any other plan it is the days charged for the stop divided by the calendar days in the renters term.

| Billing plan of the renters policy | Share of the year charged for the stop |
|---|---|
| Monthly EFT plan or monthly card plan | Whole 30-day periods in the days charged, any part period dropped, divided by 12 |
| Two-pay plan | Days charged divided by 360 |
| Any other plan (the annual plan) | Days charged divided by the calendar days in the renters term |

### Hypothetical illustrations

- Monthly plans, 89 days charged: two whole 30-day periods (60 days), the remaining 29 days dropped; share 2 divided by 12. At 90 days charged: three whole periods; share 3 divided by 12.
- Two-pay plan, 90 days charged: 90 divided by 360, a share of 0.25.
- Annual plan, 90 days charged in a 365-day term: 90 divided by 365.
